title.value: Evaluating Machine Learning-Driven Intrusion Detection Systems in IoT: Performance and Energy Consumption
title.justification: The title is taken verbatim from the research paper provided.
title.quote: Evaluating Machine Learning-Driven Intrusion Detection Systems in IoT: Performance and Energy Consumption

analysis.description: The paper evaluates the impact of Machine Learning-driven Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) on performance metrics such as CPU usage, energy consumption, and CPU load in IoT environments, both with and without the integration of Software-Defined Networking (SDN). It provides a comparative analysis of traditional ML-based IDS and Deep Learning-based IDS, showing the latter to be more efficient under various cyber threats. The study also uses statistical methods like ANOVA to analyze its experimental results.

type.justification: The study is empirical as it involves conducting experiments to evaluate the impact of ML-based IDS on performance metrics in IoT environments. It includes the analysis of data using statistical methods such as ANOVA to derive conclusions.
type.quote: To address this gap, this article presents an empirical study that evaluates the impact of state-of-the-art ML-based IDSs on performance metrics such as CPU usage, energy consumption, and CPU load.
